email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
James, saw dbt Labs open-sourced MetricFlow and co-launched Open Semantic Interchange with Snowflake and Salesforce.

At your scale the bottleneck is rarely intent, it is the lag between a signal firing and a rep acting on it. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, written, followed-up outreach autonomously, so signal-to-action latency drops and coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
James, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

Past $100M ARR you likely have more in-market accounts than reps can ever work, and the data hygiene plus manual follow-up tax only compounds as you grow. The win is measurable lift per rep, not more seats.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
James, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs' reply rate likely compares to other data-infrastructure scaleups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
James, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running ops at your scale is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ops motion? I will tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
